name: Dan Heng - Permansor Terrae
notes: DRAFT. Source: Fribbels supportSimulation (he has no scoring.simulation(), only this buffer one). Biggest guess: how the 7 rolls left after ATK%, ATK and SPD are split between HP% and DEF%. Fribbels file: vendor/hsr-optimizer/src/lib/conditionals/character/1400/PermansorTerrae.ts. Fribbels line numbers in PermansorTerrae.ts: supportSimulation 338-387, parts 340-345, substats 346-352. Facts about set effects and kits come from tools/gamedata/lc-text.mjs --set <id> and kit-text.mjs output. Written 2026-11-13 as a draft for Smitty to review; every GUESS is a choice Fribbels does not make.

relic_sets.notes: First-listed relic set (PermansorTerrae.ts:358): Self-Enshrouded Recluse 4-piece (+Shield effect; +15% CRIT DMG to allies holding his Shield).

ornament_set.name: Lushaka, the Sunken Seas
ornament_set.notes: First-listed ornament (PermansorTerrae.ts:362): Lushaka, the Sunken Seas (+5% ERR; +12% ATK to the first character in the lineup when the wearer is not first).

main_stats.notes: Fribbels options: Body ATK%, Feet SPD/ATK%, Sphere ATK%, Rope ATK%. Only Feet has a choice: SPD (first-listed), because the preset's buffStat is ATK (his Shield is 21.2% of his ATK plus 445, kit text) and a trace gives him +5 SPD, so SPD boots put him at the 133 line for one roll. GUESS only in that ATK% boots are the other option.

spd_target.reason: Turn breakpoint: 20000/150 = 133.33 SPD, so 133.34 gives 2 turns in the first 150 AV cycle (src/engine/breakpoints.test.ts pins 134 as 2 turns and 133 as 1). His Fribbels list has SPD (PermansorTerrae.ts:346-352) with no stated target.

distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: ATK%, ATK, SPD, HP%, DEF%, and buffStat ATK. Caps: ATK% 6 (three ATK% main stats), ATK 10 (Hands main). ATK% and ATK are filled to their caps because the Shield and the buff scale on his ATK. SPD: target 133.34 (K14e, turn breakpoint). 97 base + 5 (trace) + 25.032 + 4.6 = 131.632; 1 distributed roll makes 133.932 (margin 0.592), 0 is short. Caps: ATK% 6 (three ATK% main stats), ATK 10 (Hands main). ATK% and ATK are filled to their caps because the Shield and the buff scale on his ATK. GUESS: HP% 4 and DEF% 3 for the 7 leftover rolls; the preset lists HP% and DEF% but not which is worth more, and survival is modelled (K8). Changed from the earlier draft: no change to the split. Priority: file counts (ATK 10, ATK% 6, HP% 4, DEF% 3). GUESS: ATK ahead of ATK% only because of the counts (ATK is capped at 10 and does not change with main-stat swaps, so it never overflows). SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs.
